title: 007 - Age Range Check
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print valid when the age is inside the allowed range including the lower bound and prints exactly `valid`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function ageRangeCheck(array $values): int
{
    return array_sum(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value % 2 === 1));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function ageRangeCheck(array $values): int
{
    return array_sum(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value % 2 === 0));
}
hint: Look closely at the boundary comparison on the lower edge.
explanation: The lower-bound comparison is too strict. Including the minimum allowed age fixes the result.
